value.rationale: Stationary modality is a natural finite-population invariant for bistable opinion particle systems, and whether two sampled influencers must be distinct is an explicit modeling choice in the primary literature. This complete phase diagram distinguishes unique, paired, triple and fourfold exact maxima, with four the sharp all-size upper bound and an infinite Pell family. The exact same-population replacement contrast is not just a reparameterization; it changes observable finite stationary maxima. This does not purport to prove a new macroscopic phase transition or switching-time law, so its value rests on the precise natural finite-size classification.
